scope: Android/Termux Herdr migration harness only; canonical Android product/runtime files are read-only and tmux remains authoritative until live promotion gates pass.

configuration.stateRootContract: ${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/agentswitchboard/android-herdr-migration; validators must override with --state-root when they require synthetic clean state.
configuration.sourceRefreshRule: Refresh tracked upstream installation/runtime/server-start sources before broadening authority; a newer release or source change must never silently inherit v0.8.0 probe approval.

knownTraps: Deterministic validators must not auto-discover real operator artifacts. Use an isolated --state-root for synthetic status routing tests.
The published Linux ARM64 asset is aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, not a native Android target.
Linux aarch64 availability is not Android/Termux support proof.
A native aarch64-linux-android build selects Herdr's unsupported fallback platform module at the pinned source commit.
The prebuilt identity probe authorizes only exact-size/SHA-256 verified ephemeral --version execution.
Bare `herdr` auto-detect launch may spawn a detached daemon; it is forbidden in the bounded server-start probe.
The bounded server-start probe must use explicit foreground `herdr server`, isolated XDG state, HERDR_SOCKET_PATH, status server --json, and server stop.
Foreground server start/status/stop proves only bounded local server lifecycle and API IPC, not client attach, detach/reattach, background survival or agent-state detection.
A missing Herdr command is not authority to improvise an installer.
Do not use cargo install herdr unless the pinned upstream source documents that method.
Do not use curl-pipe-shell as installation proof.
Do not mutate Android device_config, phantom-process limits, or battery policy from this harness lane.
Raw phone evidence remains local and untracked; commit source snapshots, synthetic fixtures, and contracts instead.
tmux remains canonical until every promotion gate has same-device evidence.

buildTestDeploy.build: No product build; harness assets are tracked JSON, Markdown, Python, shell, and PowerShell.
buildTestDeploy.deploy: Push reviewed harness changes to an isolated feature branch and open/update its PR; live evidence mode is operator-only and must not run in hosted CI.

proofCeiling: This map proves ownership, discoverability, deterministic routing, source binding, artifact paths, validators and probe boundaries. It authorizes only the explicit ephemeral prebuilt identity probe and, after that same-device PASS, the explicit bounded foreground server start/status/stop probe. It does not prove client attach, persistence, agent-state, Android background survival, coding-agent success or tmux retirement.
